content: 1. Document all medications the patient is currently taking, including their dosages, frequency, and any recent changes to their regimen. 2. Include a detailed record of any vaccinations the patient has received, specifying the type of vaccine, date of administration, and any observed side effects. 3. Follow the guidelines and recommendations provided by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) when managing diabetes-related treatments and interventions. 4. Record any use of complementary or alternative medicine by the patient, including specific therapies, supplements, or practices, and assess their potential interactions with conventional treatments.
